verses.text: Tato wach' ko b'inaji, yelxo te wach' t'a yichanh to te ay k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata t'ayonh.
Ha heb' b'eyum yet' heb' meb'a', lajannhej heb', a Jehová ixb'o'an heb'.
Ha heb' aj pensar syil heb' tastak ay smay, skolan sb'a heb' t'ay. Haxo pax heb' malaj spensar jun, sb'eynhejb'at heb' masanto yalab'aj satkanb'at heb'.
Tato emnakil skutej ko b'a, tato ay pax yelk'och Jehová t'a ko sat, skik' ko b'eyumal, tzonh b'inaji, snajatb'i ko k 'inal.
Ha t'a yol sb'e heb' chuk, ichato te ay te' k'i'ix yet' ya'al ayemi. Haxo pax heb' stanhwej sb'a jun, manh junnhejok sb'eyek' heb' yet' heb' chuk chi'.
Tato sko k'ayb'ej heb' unin t'a wach' b'eyb'al, haxo ol och heb' icham anima'il, manhxo ol yik'kanel sb'a heb' t'ay.
Ha heb' b'eyum, icha rey yaj heb' t'a skal heb' meb'a'. Haxo pax heb' tz'ak'an k'e'en tumin majanil, yajal yaj heb' t'a skal heb' smajnan k'e'en tumin chi'.
Ha heb' anhej chukal sk'ulej, anhej yahelal ol scha heb', manhxo ol yal yixtan heb' yetanima'il heb'.
Ha heb' elb'en yuj, ol scha wach'k'olal heb' yuj spukanek' tas wach' swaji t'a skal heb' meb'a'.
Ayik spechjiel heb' b'uchumtak, tz'em numnaj telajb'ail, owal yet' tzuntzojb'ail.
Ha heb' rey, ste tzalaj heb' yet' heb' wach' spensar, sch'oxanpax swach'k'olal heb' t'a heb' wach' sloloni.
Ha Jehová stanhwan heb' aj pensar, stenanpaxek' tastak syal heb' tz'esani.
Ha heb' jaragana syal heb' to ha t'a yol sb'e heb' ay jun nok' choj ayek'i, to a nok' ijan ix milancham heb' yalani, yujto malaj snib'ej heb' sb'at munlajel.
Ha slolonel heb' ix ix smulan t'a yol sk'ab' yetb'eyum, lajan icha junok olan te jul yich, haton b'aj sb'atkan heb' skatab'ej Jehová.
Ha manh pensaril aynhejek' t'a heb' unin, skan yuj heb' tato smak'ji heb' t'a te' jixk'ab' te'.
Ha heb' tz'ixtan heb' meb'a', yujto snib'ejoch sb'a heb' b'eyumal yet' heb' smontan heb' b'eyum, a heb' chi' yuj mheb'ail ol satel heb'.
Ab'ek jun tik, ol ex in k'ayb'ej t'a tastak yalnakkan heb' aj pensar. Scham wal he k'ayb'ani.
Wach' tato tze sik'kan t'a he pensar yik wach' tzeyalub'tanhej smasanil.
Ha tikne'ik swak' wal eyojtakejeli, yik wach' tzeyak'och Jehová yipok he k'o'ol.
Tik tzin tz'ib'ej 30 lolonel t'ayex: Ha juntzanh lolonel tik, ay pensar wach' yet' jelanilal yet'nakochi.
Tato tze k'ayb'ej, ol eyojtakej tastak wach' yet' tas yel, yik wach' syal eyak'an razón wach' t'a heb' sk'anb'an yab' t'ayex.
Manh eyixtej junok meb'a' yujto max yal-laj skolan sb'a. Manh eyixtejpax junok mach malaj mach skolan t'a yichanh heb' yajal,
yujto a Jehová ol kolanok, haxo Jehová chi' ol ak'an spak t'ayex yuj schukal tas tze k'ulej chi'.
Manh junok tzex aj yet' heb' anima chuk spensar yet' pax heb' tonhej skomon chichon sk'o'ol,
haxo talaj tz'aji, tze k'ayb'an schukal b'eyb'al heb' chi', ichato wan he sut'an he b'a t'ay.
Malajokab' b'ak'inh tzeyak'och he b'a he tupan sb'ok junokxo anima,
yujto ta malaj tas tzeyutej he tupani, haxo tz'aji, a he waynub' tz'ik'chajek' t'ayex.
Manh he k'ex stz'akanhil slu'um heb' he mam eyicham yak'nakkanemi.
Ha heb' wach' syutej sb'a smunlaji, haton heb' chi' ol munlaj t'a heb' rey, manhoklaj t'a juntzanh anima malaj yelk'och ol munlaj heb', yuj chi' wach' tzeyutej he munlaji.
